metadata.description: Olaseni Bello's Claude Code mods: the Claude Brain pane and more.

plugins.name: brain-hud
plugins.description: Mod: a Jarvis-style Claude Brain pane — an interactive 3D sphere and a vector HUD that shift colour, motion and overlay with what Claude is doing.

plugins.name: focus-band
plugins.description: Mod: a focus band above the prompt with a pomodoro timer, progress bar and session stats, and Clawd the Claude mascot hopping along now and then.
